source.notes: PUT /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints/1?condition=LV_TOTAL%20%3E%203&active=true — a conditional modify of watchpoint 1, the PUT shape that earlier captures in this run never exercised. Answers 200 with the <dbg:watchpoints> list root carrying one row, and the condition comes back stored verbatim but XML-escaped: <condition>LV_TOTAL > 3</condition>. The quirk worth flagging: the returned row's id is 3, NOT the id 1 that was addressed in the PUT path — a modify retires the id it was addressed by and the server assigns a new one to the modified watchpoint. The following list (capture 941, not a cassette here — see watchpoint-list-after-hit's notes on the GET-collection collision) shows ids 2 and 3, and a later create (capture 942, also not a cassette here — same method+path as watchpoint-create-lv-total) re-uses the now-freed id 1. So watchpoint ids are small reused integers whose validity ends at the next modify of that watchpoint, not stable handles. Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
